subject: Secure SDLC: CI gating, code-review & secrets rotation evidence request
messages:
From: audit@veritasassess.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Evidence for CI gating, code-review trail, and secrets rotation (Acme Payments SOC2)

Karthik,

We are working through Acme Payments' vendor SOC2 scope and need evidence covering Redwood's secure SDLC for the inference service that Acme uses. Specifically, please provide the following artifacts for the period Jan 1 2027 - Mar 31 2027: 

- CI/CD gating logs that show automated policy failures and manual approvals (including build IDs and timestamps).
- Code review sign-off trail for changes to the inference runtime and config (PR links, reviewer names, timestamps).
- Secrets management evidence: tooling used (Vault/KMS), rotation schedule, and the last rotated keys for prod-inference.
- Change management approval minutes for any production-impacting releases in Q1, including who approved and any rollback steps.

If you have a packaged evidence bundle (zip/pdf) and a Drive link or one-time share, that would be preferable. Also note any redactions or internal-only URLs we should avoid.

Can you confirm when we can expect the initial bundle? Acme would like this by EOD Apr 5 if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Senior Assessor
Veritas Assess

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: audit@veritasassess.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for CI gating, code-review trail, and secrets rotation (Acme Payments SOC2)

Elena,

Thanks for the clear list. We've assembled an initial evidence package and attached the key artifacts below. High-level notes up front:

- CI gating: Redwood CI (internal: Redwood Build) enforces lint, unit tests, and an integration policy gate. Any gate failures block merge; manual override requires two approvals for prod branches. See attached "ci-gate-logs-202703.pdf" for a filtered export (build IDs, timestamps, status). Link to redacted build logs: https://console.redwood.com/builds/CI-2998/logs
- Code review: All PRs targeting main/prod branches require at least one peer and one maintainers team reviewer. We exported the signed-off PRs (snapshot) as "code-review-snapshots-202703.zip"; inside are PR html snapshots and reviewer comments.
- Secrets: We use HashiCorp Vault with AWS KMS-backed auto-unseal. Secrets have TTLs and periodic rotation; see the attached "vault-rotation-log-prod-20270328.csv" for the last rotation events referenced to the prod-inference service.
- Change approvals: Production-impacting releases have documented approval minutes; see "change-approval-minutes-20270329.docx" which contains the approvers list, testing signoffs, and rollback steps.

Attachments (initial): ci-gate-logs-202703.pdf; code-review-snapshots-202703.zip; vault-rotation-log-prod-20270328.csv; change-approval-minutes-20270329.docx

We're also uploading a Drive bundle with full context (redacted where necessary): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCI-evidence

If you need additional machine-readable exports (e.g., raw CI JSON or Vault audit logs), we can provide them under an NDA/secure transfer.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: audit@veritasassess.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for CI gating, code-review trail, and secrets rotation (Acme Payments SOC2)

Karthik,

Thanks for the package — useful start. A couple of clarifying questions before we close this section of the assessment: 

1) For the Vault rotation log you provided, can you confirm which key IDs correspond to the prod-inference service? We need the last rotation timestamp and the operator identity that triggered the rotation.

2) For CI gating: we see manual approvals in the PDF but would like the policy definition that enforces two approvals for prod merges (policy file or policy id).

3) Change approvals doc shows the minutes; can you confirm whether DocuSign or an equivalent e-signature record exists for the approval that transitioned release 2027-03-29 to production? If yes, please share the envelope id or link.

Could you have these clarifications and any small additional artifacts by EOD Apr 5?

Best,
Elena

On Fri, Apr 2, 2027 at 8:45 AM, karthik.iyer@redwood.com wrote:
> [attached: ci-gate-logs-202703.pdf, code-review-snapshots-202703.zip, vault-rotation-log-prod-20270328.csv, change-approval-minutes-20270329.docx]

From: dev.patel@redwood.com

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for CI gating, code-review trail, and secrets rotation (Acme Payments SOC2)

Elena / team,

Quick answers here (pulled from Vault and CI):

- Prod-inference key IDs: inf-prod-key-v3 (last rotated 2027-03-28T22:07:12Z by svc-vault-rotator@redwood.com). I attached the raw CSV export (vault-rotation-log-prod-20270328.csv) and included the key_id column for clarity.

- CI policy: The enforcement is via our platform policy file (repo: infra/ci/policies/prod-branch.json). Policy enforces: required_status_checks (lint, unit, e2e), minimum_review_count: 2, and disallows direct pushes to main. For a quick reference I pasted the relevant policy excerpt below:

"minimum_review_count: 2"
"required_status_checks: [lint, unit-tests, integration-tests]"

We can provide the policy file as a policy id export if you need it as an artifact.

- DocuSign envelope: Release 2027-03-29 approvals were recorded through DocuSign envelope id: DS-ENV-20270329-Redwood-Prod. Public link (audit view): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

Forwarding the requested clarifications and attaching again the CSV for the rotation log. Let me know if you need the Vault raw audit (we will sanitizer tokens).

Regards,
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform
dev.patel@redwood.com
